posts.name: Spiff
posts.cooked: I have to admit that I expected the big news from today to be a redesign of the main SotM website to feature Rook City more prominently. Don’t get me wrong, I’m happy that the announcement was a new expansion (more expansions are more better) but the fact still remains that if you didn’t read the blog posts or come to the forums, you might not even know that Rook City exists. None of the new heroes are listed in the “Heroes” section, nor are the new villains under “Villains”, and the posted rules are still from the core set, meaning that there’s nothing on irreducible damage or the new “H” mechanic. Might be time to add the stuff from the last expansion to the site before we get too deep into the new one, no?

posts.name: Christopher
posts.cooked:
We are certainly working on the webpage. Right now, we have far too many irons in the fire, so the webpage is a bit neglected. We are aware and working to correct it. Unfortunately, time is now a commodity that is as precious as money to us, which is sort of a nice change.

But yes, we’re on it. Just slowly. Thank you for your patience!
